message: koma is now daemon-per-session: every window runs as its own independent process, so two directories are fully isolated with no cross-talk. /resume is a swapper across all live sessions — [d] detach leaves a session cooking and reattaches live later, [k] closes the window. /new spawns another session (/new kill replaces the current). MCP servers now run once in a shared global daemon instead of once per window. And the safety harness fails closed: when the classifier can't be reached it bounces the tool call back to the model instead of silently running it.
